text:
anya: Heads-up — next release train lands Wed 2026-03-25 16:00 UTC (biweekly). With the EU holiday on Thu 2026-03-26, we should confirm cutover and who holds rollback keys. Changelog cutoff = Tue 2026-03-24 23:59 UTC. Can folks confirm their version bumps/PRs will be merged by then? Also, we need a canary window for Dedicated rollout — 30 mins. @release-bot please ping owners for open /rc PRs.

kevin: I'll take on release lead for this train. I'll run the canary and watch perf dashboards. Planning to cut the branch Mon 2026-03-23 22:00 UTC. :thumbsup:

sarah: Noted. I'll finish the changelog entry for the runtime changes and tag the PR. pinging reviewers: @mike @julia

mike: ack, I can review the runtime PR tomorrow morning. Also can we relax the flaky test gating for this train? one flaky e2e is blocking a minor bump.

julia: @mike which test? I can look into flakiness and maybe skip with a test-skip label if it's not release-blocking.

anya: it's `integration/large-batch-tests::batch_overlap` — flaky on Ampere. If it's non-functional for serving we can skip with test-skip and note in changelog.

release-bot: Automated reminder: Open release-candidate PRs older than 48h: 5 (see https://git.redwood.ai/org/repo/pulls?q=is%3Apr+label%3Arc+is%3Aopen)

kevin: I'll triage those today. For the Dedicated canary we need config: canary_percent=10, duration=30m, fallback=model-quantized-v1. Add to rollout config:
```
rollout:
  strategy: canary
  canary_percent: 10
  duration: 30m
  fallback: model-quantized-v1
```

sarah: added the config to the release manifest in #release-manifests. Also updated the changelog snippet.

ops: FYI I'll be on-call Wed 16:00-18:00 UTC for the cut and potential rollback. Add my name to the release page.

anya: thanks @kevin @sarah @ops. Action items:
- kevin: lead release and run canary
- sarah: finalize changelog + manifest
- mike/julia: review runtime PR + resolve flaky test
- ops: on-call coverage for cut

mike: all good, will do reviews tomorrow.

julia: will attempt fix, if not we'll skip with test-skip and note.

anya: OK team — last reminder: changelog cutoff Tue 2026-03-24 23:59 UTC; branch freeze Mon 2026-03-23 22:00 UTC. If anyone needs an exception, post here with justification. :calendar:

kevin: thanks — posting canary timeline to the release doc now: https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/2026-03-25

sarah: thanks, closing loop.
